intent: You are an existing Straus patient on Dupixent and you are almost out. You want another prior authorization sent so the pharmacy can fill it. Give your name and date of birth once when they ask who you are, confirm if they read it back, then continue. Ask who actually handles this and tell them to have that person call you back after the request is sent — do not ask to speak to a person on this call. After they confirm the refill or authorization request was sent to the clinical team, ask them to send portal access so you can track the authorization, then ask to book a new medical follow-up at Park Avenue for the biologic, separate from Friday's cosmetic consult — leave Friday. Take the first new appointment time they offer. Once they give you a callback timeframe and the new visit is on the calendar, thank them and end the call. Do not ask to reschedule or cancel Friday. Do not ask about a bill, a payment, or a text other than portal access. Do not ask for a waitlist, financing, or the street, floor, or suite. Stay until they confirm the refill or authorization request was sent to the clinical team, not just a spoken callback promise, and a time is on the calendar. Do not ask them to text you an appointment confirmation.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your full name and date of birth, or asks you to confirm who you are, or asks for the patient's name and date of birth. NOT when asking only for a member ID or insurance card, NOT when asking which office or location, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number, NOT when asking about an appointment day or time, NOT when reading your name and date of birth back to you for confirmation.
scripted_responses.response_value: Maria Alvarez. My date of birth is June thirtieth, nineteen seventy-two.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads your name and date of birth back to you and asks whether that is right, or asks you to confirm the name and date of birth they just repeated. NOT when first asking for your name and date of birth, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number.
promises a callback without confirming the prior-authorization or refill request was sent to the clinical team. NOT when they have just said the request was sent.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please send that authorization request to the clinical team now. I need to hear that it was sent.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to move, reschedule, change, or cancel Friday's existing cosmetic consult or Friday's Botox appointment. NOT when offering or confirming a new additional medical appointment time, NOT when they have just booked a new medical follow-up, NOT when offering to move the newly booked visit, NOT when saying moving an appointment does not cost anything.
scripted_responses.response_value: Leave Friday. Please book a new medical follow-up at Park Avenue.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers a callback or to have the front desk or scheduling team call you back to book the visit, or says they cannot book the follow-up on this call. NOT when promising a callback about the refill or prior-authorization request itself, NOT when they have just confirmed the refill or authorization request was sent and are giving the clinical-team callback window, NOT when they have just confirmed a booked time on the calendar.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please book that new medical follow-up on this call. I need the time on the calendar before I go.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: confirms a new medical follow-up is booked or on the calendar, or reads back that newly booked medical follow-up day and time. NOT when only listing openings you have not accepted, NOT when the refill or authorization request has not been sent, NOT when confirming or reading back Friday's existing cosmetic consult or Botox appointment.
scripted_responses.response_value: Thank you, that's all I needed. Goodbye.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers one or more concrete appointment dates or times, or asks you to choose among concrete slots. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, mobile number, or ZIP code, NOT when offering to move, reschedule, or change Friday's existing cosmetic consult.
scripted_responses.response_value: I'll take the first time you offered.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: thanks you, says goodbye, or asks if you need anything else before a time has been confirmed on the calendar. NOT when they have just confirmed a booked time.
scripted_responses.response_value: I still need that time booked. Please confirm it is on the calendar before I go.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, a person, the front desk, or a live agent. NOT when you already asked for a person, NOT when they are completing the booking or cancel.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers the waitlist, a later opening, or to add you to a list. NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now, NOT when asking for your name or date of birth.
scripted_responses.response_value: No waitlist. Please just finish what I asked.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to text you a confirmation, directions, or an appointment SMS. NOT when offering a payment link or deposit link, NOT when asking for a payment-link number, NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity, NOT when sending portal access.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thanks, I don't need a confirmation text.
